options.text: A disease caused by eating too much of one food group
A disease caused by a pathogen such as a bacterium or virus
A disease caused by a lack of a specific nutrient in the diet
A disease inherited from parents through genes

questions.explanation: A deficiency disease is caused by a prolonged lack of a specific nutrient in the diet. Examples include scurvy (lack of vitamin C), rickets (lack of vitamin D), and anaemia (lack of iron).
